title: Mock Draft Monday with Trevor Sikkema: Giants Land Dart a TRUE Deep Threat + Eagles Snag an ELITE WR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mock Draft Monday with Trevor Sikkema: Giants Land Dart a TRUE Deep Threat + Eagles Snag an ELITE WR
sources.description: It's another edition of 'Mock Draft Monday' with PFF's Trevor Sikkema He joins Matt Harmon to provide his five favorite potential fits for some of the top prospects in this year's draft. Sikkema places two top WR prospects in the NFC East and gives the Cowboys a chess piece to help revitalize their defense.
